name: Satricabtagene autoleucel
note: NMPA approval 22 June 2026 — third line and later CLDN18.2-positive HER2-negative gastric/GEJ

name: Sonesitatug vedotin
mechanism: Anti-CLDN18.2 antibody joined by a cleavable linker to MMAE
note: CLARITY-Gastric01 met overall survival in 2L+; licensed from KYM Biosciences (Keymed / Lepu) in 2023

name: Arcotatug tavatecan
indications: Gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
note: Phase 3 met primary endpoint; NDA accepted by China NMPA — first CLDN18.2 ADC under regulatory review

name: SHR-A1904
note: Phase 3 second-line against investigator's choice in CLDN18.2-positive patients

name: ASKB589
mechanism: Second-generation humanised anti-CLDN18.2 antibody with enhanced ADCC
note: First-line pivotal with tislelizumab and CAPOX; first patient dosed January 2024

name: Osemitamab
indications: Gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
note: Recorded as Phase 2 — the company's pipeline lists Phase III but the trials it names (TranStar101 and TranStar102) are Phase 1/2a

name: Zolbetuximab
mechanism: Chimeric IgG1 against CLDN18.2; kills through ADCC and CDC
note: Phase correction only: FDA approved Vyloy on 21 October 2024, and Open Targets still records this programme at Phase 3
